Hey Meta is closed to third-party code. Say it plainly.

Every week someone asks whether Muse can answer Hey Meta. The answer is no, and this post is the answer we link to.

✳Git-FEDPublished 2026-11-21Meta AI app ↗2 min read

Every week someone asks whether Muse can answer Hey Meta. The answer is no, and this post is the answer we link to.

The limit

Hey Meta is tied to Meta AI and closed to third-party code. No outside app can register as the assistant on the glasses or take the wake word. Muse cannot replace it.

Why we keep repeating it

The old open Muse forums filled up with workarounds that did not work, and people bought hardware expecting something it cannot do. That is the failure mode we are trying to avoid here.

What to say instead

Glasses as a Bluetooth headset. Muse voice chat on the phone through the glasses. Photos through the Meta AI app. Those three are real, and they cover most of what people actually wanted.

Moderation rule

Posts claiming Muse replaced Hey Meta get flagged, not deleted. A moderator replies with this link and the person gets a chance to correct it. Repeat claims after that are promo-style spam and go to Git-FED.
